title: Health and Social Care Management (Level 6)
description: The purpose of this program is to develop students professionally and individually self-reflecting to meet the demands of the health and social care sector and excel in a constantly evolving environment.
longDescription: The purpose of this Health and Social Care Management (Level 6) is to develop students professionally and as self-reflective practitioners who can meet the demands of the health and social care sector and excel in a constantly evolving environment. This course enhances your ability to understand health and social care challenges, analyze management issues, and devise effective solutions. It introduces you to essential concepts critical to understanding how health and social care organizations operate, ensuring that whether you pursue further education or enter the sector, you will stand out with a comprehensive understanding of the skills needed to thrive in this field. This Health and Social Care Management (Level 6) serves as a foundation for further education in the sector and enhances opportunities for rewarding employment in health and social care settings. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: Each module consists of 40 guided learning hours of material with an additional 30-50 hours worth of optional materials which comprise of recommended exercises, recommended readings and internet resources. Within the modules are self-testing exercises. You must take care in answering these. Although they are not marked nor do they count towards your final assessment, the marking is tested against your scoring on the final assessment to check for consistency of score. Successful completion of the full Level 6 International Baccalaureate Diploma in Health and Social Care will equip students with the necessary credentials to pursue careers in healthcare management, social work, nursing, healthcare administration, or other roles within the health and social care sector.

entry: For entry into Level 6 International Higher Diploma in Health and Social Care, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership, or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: After completing this Level 6 endorsed qualification, students can progress to a variety of university courses that align with their academic and career goals or potential university progression pathways.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
